name: Parents And Children
overview: Scripture teaches that the relationship between parents and children is founded on honor, discipline, and godly instruction. Children are described as a heritage from the Lord, entrusted to parents who are called to lovingly train and correct them in the way they should go, ensuring their lasting faithfulness. Honoring parents is commanded as a key to a long and blessed life, while timely discipline, though difficult, is an expression of love that guards children from destruction.
